title: Sde Dov apartment prices, project by project
note: PriceGuide data for /sde-dov/prices/ (WordPress page 4758) in AREA mode (no floor model; the first mode has no floor). Same shape as rova-4.json. Built 7.10.2026 (HAD-460), data only: nothing published. Every row, tile and mode has a src that resolves to a key in 'sources'; each source gives the URL, what it says and when it was read. Keys marked 'reused from <file>' were read by the earlier research of 7.10.2026 and copied with their numbers; every other key was opened by me on 7.10.2026 (UTC times in the key). The page shows dates only, no source names, no buyer names, no developer-company names (project names only). VAT: the developers' per-m2 averages are incl. VAT where the source says so; Ashira's averages were published without saying (the row says so). The official neighbourhood that holds the quarter, 'אזור שדה דב' (65210724), has NO medians in any quarter (re-read 7.10.2026 09:50 UTC), so the official medians are those of the adjacent 'תכנית ל' (65210022), labelled as the adjacent neighbourhood, as on the Rainbow, Dimri and Ashira pages. Calculated per-m2 values (price / area) are marked CALC in the source text. To go live: add 'sde-dov-prices' to KEYS in pg_helper.py and place [nadlan_price_guide key="sde-dov-prices"] after the page's opening paragraph (not done here).

answer: According to a review of the developers’ reports published in April 2026, the roughly 1,280 apartments sold by then in the Sde Dov quarter averaged about ₪83,000 per m², and a 4-room apartment sold for about ₪9.45 million on average. The gap between projects is wide: in the 2025 reports, from about ₪63,400 per m² at ZOHI Tel Aviv to about ₪82,600 at DIMRI YAMA, including VAT. In 2026 most projects in the quarter are selling at about ₪70,000 per m², and deals at ₪54,000-57,000 per m² were also recorded in March 2026.

modes.why: In 2026 most projects in the quarter are selling at about ₪70,000 per m². The average of all the apartments sold in the quarter up to April 2026 was about ₪83,000 per m², and the official price in the projects, before financing benefits, is ₪75,000-85,000.

modes.why: The lowest-priced deals published in the quarter in 2026: two 5-room apartments at ₪54,000-57,000 per m², and most recent deals in one of the projects in the Eshkol compound at ₪60,000-62,000. In the project that opened at ₪49,000 per m², the average has already passed ₪60,000.

calc.gap: In the Sde Dov quarter, the financing benefits in some projects amount to a 6-8% discount on the list price. Most of the developers’ averages include VAT; for ASHIRA it was not published whether they do.

src_line: This price guide draws on the developers’ reports as published, on deals reported to the Tax Authority and published, on the official median deal price by neighbourhood and on marketing prices published in the quarter. Marketed prices and estimates are marked separately and are not closing prices. Updated 7 October 2026.
